what: A swamp mangrove root system: arched prop roots reaching the ground, wood stump and a small swamp-green foliage crown - no blue water hues in wood.

views.why: commander camera at 45/30; gameplay-scale readability is the contract

style_notes: Low-Poly Diorama: chunky, faceted, flat-shaded, palette-only, readable at ~60 px. 1u = 1 tile; player = 1.55u; base at z=0, centred on (0,0). Palette from docs/ART_DIRECTION.md.
